title: Christmas Party
one_paragraph_synopsis: The office prepares and celebrates their Christmas party with various events including the struggle to bring in a large Christmas tree, a Secret Santa gift exchange that turns into a Yankee Swap, and Michael's enthusiastic but controversial party planning. Tensions arise over gift values and party supplies, while personal interactions and gift exchanges reveal character dynamics. The party includes unexpected moments such as Michael serving alcohol despite objections and Todd Packer's arrival, but the final outcomes of the party and gift exchanges remain uncertain.
